verses.sloka: सुग्रीवेणैवमुक्तस्तु हृष्टो दधिमुखः कपिः ।राघवं लक्ष्मणं चैव सुग्रीवं चाभ्यवादयत् ।। ५.६४.१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sugrīveṇaivamuktastu hṛṣṭo dadhimukhaḥ kapiḥ ।rāghavaṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ caiva sugrīvaṁ cābhyavādayat ।। 5.64.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Pleased with Sugriva's command (to send forth Angada and Hanuman) Dadhimukha offered salutations to Sugriva, Rama and Lakshmana.
translations.hindi: हनुमानजी कहने लगे-है नरव्याध्र ! सीताजी ने यह जान कर कि, मुझ पर तुम्हारा स्नेह है, शेष कार्य के सम्बन्ध में ग्ादरपूर्वक मुझ मे कहा

verses.sloka: स प्रणम्य च सुग्रीवं राघवौ च महाबलौ ।वानरैः सहितैः शूरैर्दिवमेवोत्पपात ह ।। ५.६४.२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa praṇamya ca sugrīvaṁ rāghavau ca mahābalau ।vānaraiḥ sahitaiḥ śūrairdivamevotpapāta ha ।। 5.64.2 ।।।।

translations.english: Dadhimukha offered his obeisance to Sugriva and the mighty Rama and Lakshmana and rose up to the sky followed by the vanaras.
translations.hindi: है कपे ! तुम विविध प्रकार से दशरथनन्दन श्रोरामचन्द्र को समझाना जिससे बे शीघ्र युद्ध में रावण को मार मझे मिलें

verses.sloka: स यथैवागतः पूर्वं तथैव त्वरितं गतः ।निपत्य गगनाद्भूमौ तद्वनं प्रविवेश ह ।। ५.६४.३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa yathaivāgataḥ pūrvaṁ tathaiva tvaritaṁ gataḥ ।nipatya gaganādbhūmau tadvanaṁ praviveśa ha ।। 5.64.3 ।।।।

translations.english: Descending into Madhuvanam, Dadhimukha saw all the monkey troops free from intoxication (of honeywine).
translations.hindi: है वीर ! यदि तुम चाहो तो किसी गप्त स्थान में एक दिन और टिके रहो श्रौर अपनी थकावट मिटा लो । फिर कल चले जाना

verses.sloka: स प्रविष्टो मधुवनं ददर्श हरियूथपान् ।विमदानुत्थितान् सर्वान् मेहमानान् मधूदकम् ।। ५.६४.४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa praviṣṭo madhuvanaṁ dadarśa hariyūthapān ।vimadānutthitān sarvān mehamānān madhūdakam ।। 5.64.4 ।।।।

translations.english: Descending into Madhuvanam, Dadhimukha saw all the monkey troops free from intoxication (of honeywine).

verses.sloka: स तानुपागमद्वीरो बद्ध्वा करपुटाञ्जलिम् ।उवाच वचनं श्लक्ष्णमिदं हृष्टवदङ्गदम् ।। ५.६४.५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tānupāgamadvīro baddhvā karapuṭāñjalim ।uvāca vacanaṁ ślakṣṇamidaṁ hṛṣṭavadaṅgadam ।। 5.64.5 ।।।।

translations.english: Heroic Dadhimukha went to Angada, holding his cupped palms reverentially and spoke these conciliatory words with joy:
translations.hindi: तुम्हारे यहाँ से वहाँ जाने और वहाँ से यहाँ फिर आने तक, निएचय _ हौँ मुझे अपने जीवित रहने में भी सन्देह है

verses.sloka: सौम्य रोषो न कर्तव्यो यदेभिरभिवारितः ।अज्ञानाद्रक्षिभिः क्रोधाद्भवन्तः प्रतिषेधिताः ।। ५.६४.६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: saumya roṣo na kartavyo yadebhirabhivāritaḥ ।ajñānādrakṣibhiḥ krodhādbhavantaḥ pratiṣedhitāḥ ।। 5.64.6 ।।।।

translations.english: "O handsome one, do not react harshly at these guards who have obstructed your companions out of ignorance and fury.
translations.hindi: म इस दुदशा में पड़ी हूं श्रौर दुःख पर दुःख सह रही हूं। प्रत: में बड़ी . अभागिनी हूं । तुम्हारे चले जाने पर श्रथवा तुम्हारी भनुपस्थिति में मुझे फिर बड़ा भारी दुःख होगा

verses.sloka: युवराजस्त्वमीशश्च वनस्यास्य महाबल ।मौर्ख्यात् पूर्वं कृतो दोषस्तं भवान् क्षन्तुमर्हति ।। ५.६४.७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yuvarājastvamīśaśca vanasyāsya mahābala ।maurkhyāt pūrvaṁ kṛto doṣastaṁ bhavān kṣantumarhati ।। 5.64.7 ।।।।

translations.english: "O mighty Angada you are heir apparent and also king. Out of foolishness I obstructed you. You ought to pardon me this mistake.
translations.hindi: ग्रयं च वीर सन्देहस्तिष्ठतीव ममाग्रतः । समहास्त्वत्सहायष येष हयक्षव हरीश्वर HSI ५७० सुन्दरकाण्डे हे वीर ! मुझे एक बात का बड़ा सन्देह है कि, तुम्हारे बडे सहायक रीक्छो आर वानरों में

verses.sloka: आख्यातं हि मया गत्वा पितृव्यस्य तवानघ ।इहोपयातं सर्वेषामेतेषां वनचारिणाम् ।। ५.६४.८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ākhyātaṁ hi mayā gatvā pitṛvyasya tavānagha ।ihopayātaṁ sarveṣāmeteṣāṁ vanacāriṇām ।। 5.64.8 ।।।।

translations.english: "O blameless prince I have already told your father's elder brother and all the forestdwellers about your arrival here.

verses.sloka: स त्वदागमनं श्रुत्वा सहैभिर्हरियूथपैः ।प्रहृष्टो न तु रुष्टो ऽसौ वनं श्रुत्वा प्रधर्षितम् ।। ५.६४.९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tvadāgamanaṁ śrutvā sahaibhirhariyūthapaiḥ ।prahṛṣṭo na tu ruṣṭo 'sau vanaṁ śrutvā pradharṣitam ।। 5.64.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "He was not angry at your destruction of the garden. On the other hand, he was very glad to hear about your arrival.

verses.sloka: प्रहृष्टो मां पितृव्यस्ते सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः ।शीघ्रं प्रेषय सर्वांस्तानिति होवाच पार्थिवः ।। ५.६४.१० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: prahṛṣṭo māṁ pitṛvyaste sugrīvo vānareśvaraḥ ।śīghraṁ preṣaya sarvāṁstāniti hovāca pārthivaḥ ।। 5.64.10 ।।।।

translations.english: "Your father's brother, Sugriva, the lord of vanaras felt very glad and indeed asked me to send you quickly."
translations.hindi: भतः हे कार्य करने वालों में श्रेष्ठ ! हे वीर ! तुमने इस दुष्कर कार्य के करने का क्या उपाय स्थिर किया है

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा दधिमुखस्येदं वचनं श्लक्ष्णमङ्गदः ।अब्रवीत्तान् हरिश्रेष्ठो वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः ।। ५.६४.११ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śrutvā dadhimukhasyedaṁ vacanaṁ ślakṣṇamaṅgadaḥ ।abravīttān hariśreṣṭho vākyaṁ vākyaviśāradaḥ ।। 5.64.11 ।।।।

translations.english: At these good words from Dadhimukha, Angada, the monkey leader, an eloquent speaker said this:.
translations.hindi: हे शत्रुनिहन्ता ! यद्यपि तुम अकेले ही सहज में इस काम को पूरा कर सकते हो तयापि ऐसा करने से केवल तुम्हारे यश और वस का बखान होगा

verses.sloka: शङ्के श्रुतो ऽयं वृत्तान्तो रामेण हरियूथपाः ।तत्क्षमं नेह नः स्थातुं कृते कार्ये परन्तपाः ।। ५.६४.१२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śaṅke śruto 'yaṁ vṛttānto rāmeṇa hariyūthapāḥ ।tatkṣamaṁ neha naḥ sthātuṁ kṛte kārye parantapāḥ ।। 5.64.12 ।।।।

translations.english: "O scorcher of enemies I presume Rama has already heard the news of our arrival on accomplishment of the task. Hence it is not proper for us to tarry here.
translations.hindi: यदि श्रौरामचन्द्रजो रावण को उसकी सारी सेना के साथ मार एवं विजय प्राप्त कर मुझे अयोध्या ले चलें, तो उनकी नामवरी हो

verses.sloka: पीत्वा मधु यथाकामं विश्रान्ता वनचारिणः ।किं शेषं गमनं तत्र सुग्रीवो यत्र मे गुरुः ।। ५.६४.१३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pītvā madhu yathākāmaṁ viśrāntā vanacāriṇaḥ ।kiṁ śeṣaṁ gamanaṁ tatra sugrīvo yatra me guruḥ ।। 5.64.13 ।।।।

translations.english: "The vanaras of the forest have taken rest after drinking as much honey as they desired. What is left here to do? We have to go wherever Sugriva is."

verses.sloka: सर्वे यथा मां वक्ष्यन्ति समेत्य हरियूथपाः ।तथा ऽस्मि कर्ता कर्तव्ये भवद्भिः परवानहम् ।। ५.६४.१४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sarve yathā māṁ vakṣyanti sametya hariyūthapāḥ ।tathā 'smi kartā kartavye bhavadbhiḥ paravānaham ।। 5.64.14 ।।।।

translations.english: Angada said to the vanara troops assembled, "Tell me what we have to do. I shall act as you wish.
translations.hindi: यदि शत्रु-सन्य विघ्वंसकारी श्रीरामचन्द्रजी अपनी सेना लाकर लङा को पाट दें और मुझे ले जायें तो यह कार्य उनके स्वरूपानुरूप हो

verses.sloka: नाज्ञापयितुमीशो ऽहं युवराजो ऽस्मि यद्यपि ।अयुक्तं कृतकर्माणो यूयं धर्षयितुं मया ।। ५.६४.१५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nājñāpayitumīśo 'haṁ yuvarājo 'smi yadyapi ।ayuktaṁ kṛtakarmāṇo yūyaṁ dharṣayituṁ mayā ।। 5.64.15 ।।।।

translations.english: "Even though I am heir apparent, it is not proper for me to order you.You have accomplished the purpose and to command you is not befitting on my part."

verses.sloka: ब्रुवतश्चाङ्गदश्यैवं श्रुत्वा वचनमव्ययम् ।प्रहृष्टमनसो वाक्यमिदमूचुर्वनौकसः ।। ५.६४.१६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bruvataścāṅgadaśyaivaṁ śrutvā vacanamavyayam ।prahṛṣṭamanaso vākyamidamūcurvanaukasaḥ ।। 5.64.16 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing Angada's valuable words said in that way, the vanaras repled:
translations.hindi: हे श्रीरामचन्द्र ! इस प्रकार से नम्रता श्रौर युक्तियुक्त सीता देवी केः बचन सुन, मेने पीछे से उत्तर देते हुए कहा

verses.sloka: एवं वक्ष्यति को राजन् प्रभुः सन् वानरर्षभ ।ऐश्वर्यमदमत्तो हि सर्वो ऽहमिति मन्यते ।। ५.६४.१७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evaṁ vakṣyati ko rājan prabhuḥ san vānararṣabha ।aiśvaryamadamatto hi sarvo 'hamiti manyate ।। 5.64.17 ।।।।

translations.english: "O king O bull among monkeys we think you are an exception to those to whom prosperity brings arrogance.
translations.hindi: हे देवि ! रीछ और वानरों के अधिपति वानरश्रेष्ठ सुग्रीव बड़े पराक्रमी a. ~ हैं। वे ग्रापके उद्धार का संकल्प कर चुके हैं

verses.sloka: तव चेदं सुसदृशं वाक्यं नान्यस्य कस्यचित् ।सन्नतिर्हि तवाख्याति भविष्यच्छुभयोग्यताम् ।। ५.६४.१८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tava cedaṁ susadṛśaṁ vākyaṁ nānyasya kasyacit ।sannatirhi tavākhyāti bhaviṣyacchubhayogyatām ।। 5.64.18 ।।।।

translations.english: "You alone could speak such words. Your humility speaks of your fitness for a bright future.
translations.hindi: उन सुग्रीव की; ग्राज्ञा के वश में महापराक्रमी, वीयंवान, महाबली भ्रौर इच्छागामी भनेक वानर हूँ

verses.sloka: सर्वे वयमपि प्राप्तास्तत्र गन्तुं कृतक्षणाः ।स यत्र हरिवीराणां सुग्रीवः पतिरव्ययः ।। ५.६४.१९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sarve vayamapi prāptāstatra gantuṁ kṛtakṣaṇāḥ ।sa yatra harivīrāṇāṁ sugrīvaḥ patiravyayaḥ ।। 5.64.19 ।।।।

translations.english: All of us have come here, ready to set out at any moment for wherever Sugriva, the immortal lord of the vanara heroes, may be.

verses.sloka: त्वया ह्यनुक्तैर्हरिभिर्नैव शक्यं पदात्पदम् ।क्वचिद्गन्तुं हरिश्रेष्ठ ब्रूमः सत्यमिदं तु ते ।। ५.६४.२० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tvayā hyanuktairharibhirnaiva śakyaṁ padātpadam ।kvacidgantuṁ hariśreṣṭha brūmaḥ satyamidaṁ tu te ।। 5.64.20 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Angada the best of vanaras without your command none will find it possible to put forward even a single step."
translations.hindi: उन महाबली महाभाग वानरों ने भ्राकाशमागं से गमन कर कितनी ही बार पृथिवी को परिक्रमा की है

verses.sloka: एवं तु वदतां तेषामङ्गदः प्रत्यभाषत ।बाढं गच्छाम इत्युक्त्वा खमुत्पेतुर्महाबलाः ।। ५.६४.२१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evaṁ tu vadatāṁ teṣāmaṅgadaḥ pratyabhāṣata ।bāḍhaṁ gacchāma ityuktvā khamutpeturmahābalāḥ ।। 5.64.21 ।।।।

translations.english: Thus addressed by all the vanaras, Angada said 'Well, let us go'. Then the powerful vanaras rose up the sky.
translations.hindi: मेरी बराबर झर मुझसे भी भ्रधिक बली भ्रौर पराक्रमी वानर वहाँ हें। मुझसे हीनपराक्रम वाला ्रर्वात्‌ कम बलवाला एक भी वानर सुग्रीव कै "पास नहीं है

verses.sloka: उत्पतन्तमनूत्पेतुः सर्वे ते हरियूथपाः ।कृत्वा ऽ ऽकाशं निराकाशं यन्त्रोत्क्षिप्ता इवाचलाः ।। ५.६४.२२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: utpatantamanūtpetuḥ sarve te hariyūthapāḥ ।kṛtvā ' 'kāśaṁ nirākāśaṁ yantrotkṣiptā ivācalāḥ ।। 5.64.22 ।।।।

translations.english: All the vanara troops sprang up into the air as though there was no sky, like stones shattered by machines from the mountains rise up.
translations.hindi: जब में ही यहाँ भा गया, तब उन महाबलियों का तो पूछना ही क्या है ? देखो, दूत बना कर छोटे ही भेजे जाते हैं, बडे नहीं

verses.sloka: ते ऽम्बरं सहसोत्पत्य वेगवन्तः प्लवङ्गमाः ।विनदन्तो महानादं घना वातेरिता यथा ।। ५.६४.२३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: te 'mbaraṁ sahasotpatya vegavantaḥ plavaṅgamāḥ ।vinadanto mahānādaṁ ghanā vāteritā yathā ।। 5.64.23 ।।।।

translations.english: The swift monkeys roared aloud as though they went up the sky like thundering clouds driven by the wind.
translations.hindi: हे देवि ! ध्व तुम सन्तप्त न हो । दीनता त्याग बो। वानर एक ही छलाँग में लंका में झा जायेंगे

verses.sloka: अङ्गदे समनुप्राप्ते सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः ।उवाच शोकोपहतं रामं कमललोचनम् ।। ५.६४.२४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: aṅgade samanuprāpte sugrīvo vānarādhipaḥ ।uvāca śokopahataṁ rāmaṁ kamalalocanam ।। 5.64.24 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing the griefstricken, lotuseyed Rama, the lord of the vanaras Sugriva said this before the arrival of Angada:
translations.hindi: हे महाभागे ! वे दोनों पुरुषसिह मेरी पीठ पर सवार हो उदित हुए चन्द्र भोर सूर्ये की तरह यहाँ प्रा जायेंगे

verses.sloka: समाश्वसिहि भद्र ते दृष्टा देवी न संशयः ।नागन्तुमिह शक्यं तैरतीते समये हि नः ।। ५.६४.२५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: samāśvasihi bhadra te dṛṣṭā devī na saṁśayaḥ ।nāgantumiha śakyaṁ tairatīte samaye hi naḥ ।। 5.64.25 ।।।।

translations.english: "Trust me, Rama. Be blessed. The vanaras have seen the divine lady. There is no doubt. It is not possible for them to come here after exceeding the time limit (in their search for Sita).
translations.hindi: हे देवि ! शत्रुहन्ता और सिंह की तरह पराक्रमी श्रीरामचन्द्र श्रौर लक्ष्मण को तुम धनुष हाथ में लिये शीघ्र हो लंका के द्वार पर श्राया. हुश्रा' देल्ञोगी

verses.sloka: न मत्सकाशमागच्छेत् कृत्ये हि विनिपातिते ।युवराजो महाबाहुः प्लवतां प्रवरो ऽङ्गदः ।। ५.६४.२६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: na matsakāśamāgacchet kṛtye hi vinipātite ।yuvarājo mahābāhuḥ plavatāṁ pravaro 'ṅgadaḥ ।। 5.64.26 ।।।।

translations.english: "My heir apparent, the strongarmed Angada, and the best of the monkeys is endowed with virtues. He would not come near me if his mission had failed.
translations.hindi: सुन्द रका ण्डे हे रघुनन्दन ! उस समय तुम्हारे शोक से पीडित सीताजी इस प्रकार के शुभ भ्रौर प्यारे वचनों से प्रसन्न हुईं | उनकी दीनता दूर हुई भौर वे चान्त हुईं

verses.sloka: यद्यप्यकृतकृत्यानामीदृशः स्यादुपक्रमः ।भवेत् स दीनवदनो भ्रान्तविप्लुतमानसः ।। ५.६४.२७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadyapyakṛtakṛtyānāmīdṛśaḥ syādupakramaḥ ।bhavet sa dīnavadano bhrāntaviplutamānasaḥ ।। 5.64.27 ।।।।

translations.english: "In case the vanaras have returned without accomplishing the task, Angada would have assumed a pathetic face, perplexed and unsteady in mind.

verses.sloka: पितृपैतामहं चैतत् पूर्वकैरभिरक्षितम् ।न मे मधुवनं हन्यादहृष्टः प्लवगेश्वरः ।। ५.६४.२८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pitṛpaitāmahaṁ caitat pūrvakairabhirakṣitam ।na me madhuvanaṁ hanyādahṛṣṭaḥ plavageśvaraḥ ।। 5.64.28 ।।।।

translations.english: "If Angada, lord of the vanaras had not been happy, he would not have destroyed the Madhuvanam of my father's and my grandfather's time. O Rama, follower of righteous practices, Kausalya has an excellent son in you. Trust me.
translations.hindi: तुम शीघ्र ही देखोगी कि, वनवास की श्रवधि पुरी कर, शत्रु दमनकारी श्रोरामचन्द्रजी तुम्हारे साथ श्रयोध्या के राजसिंहासन पर भ्रासीन हैं

verses.sloka: कौसल्या सुप्रजा राम समाश्वसिहि सुव्रत ।दृष्टा देवी न सन्देहो न चान्येन हनूमता ।। ५.६४.२९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kausalyā suprajā rāma samāśvasihi suvrata ।dṛṣṭā devī na sandeho na cānyena hanūmatā ।। 5.64.29 ।।।।

translations.english: "Hanuman is the one who has accomplished this task. Who else can? No doubt, he has seen Sita.

verses.sloka: न ह्यन्यः कर्मणो हेतुः साधने ऽस्य हनूमतः ।हनूमति हि सिद्धिश्च मतिश्च मतिसत्तम ।व्यवसायश्च वीर्यं च सूर्य तेज इव ध्रुवम् ।। ५.६४.३० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: na hyanyaḥ karmaṇo hetuḥ sādhane 'sya hanūmataḥ ।hanūmati hi siddhiśca matiśca matisattama ।vyavasāyaśca vīryaṁ ca sūrya teja iva dhruvam ।। 5.64.30 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Rama, the best among the wise just like the luminosity that abides in the Sun, capacity to succeed, energy, intelligence, even courage and steadfastness reside in Hanuman.

verses.sloka: जाम्बवान् यत्र नेता स्यादङ्गदश्च बलेश्वरः ।हनुमांश्चाप्यधिष्ठाता न तस्य गतिरन्यथा ।। ५.६४.३१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: jāmbavān yatra netā syādaṅgadaśca baleśvaraḥ ।hanumāṁścāpyadhiṣṭhātā na tasya gatiranyathā ।। 5.64.31 ।।।।

translations.english: "Where Jambavan is the leader, Angada the commander of the army and Hanuman the guiding force, the end result will not be otherwise.

verses.sloka: मा भूश्चिन्तासमायुक्तः सम्प्रत्यमितविक्रम ।। ५.६४.३२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: mā bhūścintāsamāyuktaḥ sampratyamitavikrama ।। 5.64.32 ।।।।

translations.english: "You are extremely valiant and it is unbecoming of you to be anxious at this time Rama. Just then chatterings of the monkeys were heard from the sky as they roared in pride talking of Hanuman's achievement. Having successfully completed the errand, they have arrived at Kishkinda.

verses.sloka: ततः किलकिलाशब्दं शुश्रावासन्नमम्बरे ।हनुमत्कर्मदृप्तानां नर्दतां काननौकसाम् ।किष्किन्धामुपयातानां सिद्धिं कथयतामिव ।। ५.६४.३३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kilakilāśabdaṁ śuśrāvāsannamambare ।hanumatkarmadṛptānāṁ nardatāṁ kānanaukasām ।kiṣkindhāmupayātānāṁ siddhiṁ kathayatāmiva ।। 5.64.33 ।।।।

translations.english: "You are extremely valiant and it is unbecoming of you to be anxious at this time Rama. Just then chatterings of the monkeys were heard from the sky as they roared in pride talking of Hanuman's achievement. Having successfully completed the errand, they have arrived at Kishkinda.

verses.sloka: ततः श्रुत्वा निनादं तं कपीनां कपिसत्तमः ।आयताञ्चितलाङ्गूलः सो ऽभवद्धृष्टमानसः ।। ५.६४.३४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śrutvā ninādaṁ taṁ kapīnāṁ kapisattamaḥ ।āyatāñcitalāṅgūlaḥ so 'bhavaddhṛṣṭamānasaḥ ।। 5.64.34 ।।।।

translations.english: The great Sugriva heard the roar of the monkeys and was extremely happy. He kept raising and shaking his long tail in joy.

verses.sloka: आजग्मुस्ते ऽपि हरयो रामदर्शनकांक्षिणः ।अङ्गदं पुरतः कृत्वा हनूमन्तं च वानरम् ।। ५.६४.३५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ājagmuste 'pi harayo rāmadarśanakāṁkṣiṇaḥ ।aṅgadaṁ purataḥ kṛtvā hanūmantaṁ ca vānaram ।। 5.64.35 ।।।।

translations.english: The joyful monkeys with Angada and Hanuman leading them descended with eagerness to have a close look at Rama.

verses.sloka: ते ऽङ्गदप्रमुखा वीराः प्रहृष्टाश्च मुदा ऽन्विताः ।निपेतुर्हरिराजस्य समीपे राघवस्य च ।। ५.६४.३६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: te 'ṅgadapramukhā vīrāḥ prahṛṣṭāśca mudā 'nvitāḥ ।nipeturharirājasya samīpe rāghavasya ca ।। 5.64.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Angada the chief along with the heroic monkeys very joyfully and exuberantly descended close to Sugriva, the king of monkeys and Rama.

verses.sloka: हनुमांश्च महाबाहुः प्रणम्य शिरसा ततः ।नियतामक्षतां देवीं राघवाय न्यवेदयत् ।। ५.६४.३७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hanumāṁśca mahābāhuḥ praṇamya śirasā tataḥ ।niyatāmakṣatāṁ devīṁ rāghavāya nyavedayat ।। 5.64.37 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the strongarmed Hanuman with his head bowed down offered salutations and reported, 'Divine lady Sita with her constant devotion to Sri Rama is sound in body'.

verses.sloka: निश्चितार्थस्ततस्तस्मिन् सुग्रीवः पवनात्मजे ।लक्ष्मणः प्रीतिमान् प्रीतं बहुमानादवैक्षत ।। ५.६४.३८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: niścitārthastatastasmin sugrīvaḥ pavanātmaje ।lakṣmaṇaḥ prītimān prītaṁ bahumānādavaikṣata ।। 5.64.38 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing the nectarlike words from Hanuman that Sita was found, Rama and Lakshmana were delighted.

verses.sloka: प्रीत्या च रममाणो ऽथ राघवः परवीरहा ।बहुमानेन महता हनुमन्तमवैक्षत ।। ५.६४.३९ ।।
verses.transliteration: prītyā ca ramamāṇo 'tha rāghavaḥ paravīrahā ।bahumānena mahatā hanumantamavaikṣata ।। 5.64.39 ।।

translations.english: Sugriva and Lakshmana glanced at Hanuman respectfully with affection thinking surely Hanuman alone has succeeded.
